name: What preparations do I need to make before my bathroom countertop replacement?

mainEntity.name: What preparations do I need to make before my bathroom countertop replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your bathroom countertop replacement, you should clear everything from the existing countertop and inside the vanity cabinets to ensure clear access for the installers. Protect your bathroom floor and pathways with drop cloths. Make sure there is clear access from the entry of your home to the bathroom. Discuss with your contractor any specific requirements for disconnecting plumbing or electrical components, and confirm if these services are included in the scope of work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before replacement, clear your countertop and vanity, protect floors, and ensure clear access for installers; confirm plumbing/electrical disconnection details with your contractor.
